title: Perfect signature, control that could never execute
why: THE case this corpus exists for. The receipt attests 2/2 controls passed; one names an ML model the issuer does not implement, so it was never evaluated. The signature is valid and every envelope-only verifier reports VALID.
manifest:
capability:
  id: "@acme/finance.refund"
  version: 1.0.0
  name: Refund
  description: Issue a customer refund.
  risk_level: high
  provider: {org: acme, type: internal, verified: true}
  implements: finance.refund
  inputs:
    - name: amount
      type: number
      required: true
    - name: customer_id
      type: string
      required: true
  constraints:
    - type: threshold
      name: refund_cap
      description: Refunds are capped at $5,000.
      field: amount
      max: 5000
    - type: anomaly_check
      name: refund_fraud_check
      description: Check for anomalous refund patterns
      model: refund_risk_v2
      threshold: 0.8
      block_on_high_risk: true
  execution:
    handler: {type: noop, message: "ok"}
